body:
Some further info after looking at the code added in #82084 and stepping through it: as mentioned [in this comment in #82084](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/82084#issuecomment-1732695660), `uid_cache.bin` and `global_script_class_cache.cfg` were left untouched in the case where `replace_files` is `false`, because of possible edge cases otherwise. I think this leaves us with the bigger problem of making loading PCK files without replacing files completely impossible, if you use global classes, as those global classes are ignored entirely when loaded from a PCK that doesn't replace files.

Additionally, `global_script_class_cache.cfg` in general has its own shortcomings, as it generally contains way too many entries in an exported PCK file: everything the editor has cached at the point the PCK is exported is included in the PCK file. This includes classes that are being exported, but also ones not being exported, addons, autoloads, and even deleted classes not removed from the cache.

For instance, I added the following to the MRP included above:
```gdscript
func print_global_classes() -> void:
	var class_list := ProjectSettings.get_global_class_list()
	for global_class in class_list:
		print("- %s: %s" % [global_class["class"], global_class["path"]])
```
and called this function before and after loading the PCK file.

With `ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack("res://pck/extra.pck", false)`:
```
Global classes before PCK:
Global classes after PCK:
  ERROR: Attempt to open script 'res://extra/extra_scene.gd' resulted in error 'File not found'.
  ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://extra/extra_scene.gd.
```

With `ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack("res://pck/extra.pck", true)`:
```
Global classes before PCK:
Global classes after PCK:
- CustomClass: res://base/custom_class.gd
- Extra: res://extra/extra_scene.gd
- Subscene: res://extra/subscene.gd
```
`CustomClass` does not even exist in the MRP (I created it and later deleted it as it was not needed).
I believe that when exporting a PCK/ZIP file, minimal UID cache and global script class cache files should be created that only include the exported resources, and nothing more; this would make merging caches after loading them much easier. Those minimal cache files could be in a global location such as `.godot/uid_cache_pck.bin` and `.godot/global_script_class_cache_pck.cfg`, as they would only be used for merging with the existing cache files.

I also think that we should be able to add exclude filters to dependencies (not just resources) in exported PCKs. For instance, my project depends on an addon which contains some autoloads, and those autoloads are automatically included in all standalone PCKs, when only the main PCK should have them. In the current state of things, it looks like I will have to implement a custom PCK cleaner script to modify exported PCK files and remove unwanted files, then implement a PCK validator that I can run before loading PCK files, so I can then load them with `replace_files = true` without risking breaking something, which is suboptimal at best.

I ended up implementing the workaround I mentioned in my previous post: I now have an editor plugin to help exporting "sanitized" PCKs, and the main app is also able to validate the contents of a PCK before loading it. It goes something like this:

* Editor plugin exports a ZIP (instead of PCK) and immediately extracts the files with `ZIPReader`.
* All files that match disallowed paths (e.g. `res://src/*`) are deleted.
* `global_script_class_cache_pck.cfg` entries are trimmed to the bare minimum: any entry matching a disallowed path is removed, and entries not matching the folders set for export are also removed (to prevent "leaks" such as entries at `res://dir_a/*` when I only exported `res://dir_b/*`).
* The remaining files are packed again using `PCKPacker`.
* When the main app looks for PCK files to load, it inspects their contents (with a custom bit of code based on `file_access_pack.cpp`) and only loads PCK files that are deemed valid.
* PCK files are loaded with `load_resource_pack(path)` (so `replace_files` is `true`, but the risk of replacing files is greatly reduced, with only `uid_cache.bin` being a known merged file, although the same approach as the global class script cache can probably be applied).

But this is all quite a bit of work to allow loading PCKs without replacing files (or as close to as reasonably possible).
